purpose: Small normative HOUSE seam above private runtimes. Own identity, observations, intent, evidence and projections; outsource protocol/device churn.
law: One physical world, stable HOUSE identities, many unequal projections, explicit authority boundaries, append-only evidence, bounded effects, exact RETURN.

kernel.rule: If a feature cannot be expressed as one of these nouns or a pure projection over them, it is not kernel state.

flow: SOURCE -> OBSERVATION -> HOUSE STATE -> PROJECTION -> INTENT -> POLICY -> ADAPTER -> WORLD -> OBSERVATION + RECEIPT -> RETURN

handoff.purpose: Allow another human or agent to resume HOUSE work without private chat history.

existing_assets./house/confluence.json: lineage/donor map; informative, not runtime kernel

non_goals: HA entity IDs as HOUSE identity

promotion.phase_1: READ: bind 10 real HA capabilities and normalize observations.
promotion.phase_2: SHADOW: compile intents to WOULD_SEND receipts with no external effect.
promotion.phase_3: ACT: permit only explicitly allowlisted low-risk capabilities after replay/reconnect tests pass.
